quarterly_data.quarter: Rocket Lab press release: Rocket Lab Secures Largest-Ever Electron Commercial Deal: (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab signed a multi-year launch agreement with Tokyo-based Synspective for 20 new Electron missions - its largest commercial launch contract for Electron - to launch 20 StriX SAR satellites to sun-synchronous orbit from Launch Complex 1, annually from 2028 through 2031; total Electron missions for Synspective rise to 47, the most of any Rocket Lab launch customer (remaining terms undisclosed). Rocket Lab says this year's wave of multi-launch contracts pushed its launch backlog beyond 100 missions. CEO Peter Beck: 'Signing twenty launches in a single deal is a massive vote of confidence not just in Electron, but in the launch cadence, mission reliability, and orbital precision that Rocket Lab consistently delivers.'
quarterly_data.figure: 20 new Electron missions (2028 through 2031); 47 Synspective missions in total; launch backlog beyond 100 missions
